name: @usesonar/monorepo
description: Sonar turns a thin identity seed into progressive person and company data. The workspace implements one contract across a raw Ky client, an Effect client, React hooks, Eve tools, and a private in-memory backend.
author: Cyrus Nouroozi

scripts.build: mise exec -- bun run --filter '@usesonar/api' build && mise exec -- bun run --filter '@usesonar/effect' build && mise exec -- bun run --cwd packages/backend --if-present build && mise exec -- bun run --filter '@usesonar/react' build && mise exec -- bun run --filter '@usesonar/eve' build && sidecars="$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 'packages/*/src/*.d.ts')" && test -z "$sidecars"
scripts.check:packages: publint node_modules/@usesonar/api && publint node_modules/@usesonar/effect && publint node_modules/@usesonar/react && publint node_modules/@usesonar/eve && attw --pack node_modules/@usesonar/api --profile esm-only && attw --pack node_modules/@usesonar/effect --profile esm-only && attw --pack node_modules/@usesonar/react --profile esm-only && attw --pack node_modules/@usesonar/eve --profile esm-only
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/api/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/effect/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/backend/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/eve/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p apps/next/tsconfig.json --pretty false
